title: MinebeaMitsumi AF VCM / OIS actuator production commenced (Cebu, Philippines)
detail: Product page: AF VCM and OIS actuators 'commenced operation 2005', developed at Mitsumi Yamagata, made at Cebu Mitsumi; main users 'smartphone makers'; no XR/wearable mention.

title: TDK announces $126M purchase of Hutchinson Technology (CML's SMA partner)
detail: Origin of SMA know-how inside TDK's camera-actuator group; Hutchinson was CML's original SMA OIS manufacturing partner.

title: Alps Alpine ATMC1Z9 bi-directional AF actuator enters mass production
Alps Alpine begins mass production of SMA actuator (30 µm wire, ~40% smaller than VCM)
detail: ~40% smaller projected area and >10x thrust vs Alps VCM; 60% of VCM footprint for a 1,000 mg lens; no magnets/Hall sensors; Nagaoka plant. Targets smartphones; no XR/CML mention in Alps' text.

title: Alps Alpine samples piezoelectric zoom actuator (mm–cm travel, 3 V drive)
detail: Piezo actuator for smartphone optical zoom; samples from Jan 2023; also drones, surveillance, industrial. No XR mention.

title: Meta moving-element AF filing cites LG Innotek, Samsung, Nidec prior art
detail: Cross-link: US 2025/0189869 cites Korean/Japanese VCM makers (examiner/applicant citations only, not a supply relationship).

title: TDK signs framework to transfer camera-module actuator business to Q Tech chairman's vehicle (QT Investment)
detail: TDK signed a Framework Agreement to transfer its Micro Actuator Solution (camera-module actuator) business to Q Technology Investment Inc. (BVI; Chairman He Ningning), completion planned March 2026. Q Tech filed an HKEX inside-information notice the same day:

title: Meta-Korea link: Seoul posting prefers VCM AF actuator experience
detail: Cross-link: Meta Seoul Optical Systems Engineer job (AR glasses optics) names 'AF camera actuator (e.g. VCM)' as preferred; suggests Korean VCM supply-chain familiarity, no supplier named.

title: The Elec: LG Innotek holds over 50% share in iPhone 17 folded-zoom OIS
detail: Korean VCM/OIS maker coverage (Jahwa, LG Innotek) is all iPhone folded-zoom OIS; no XR actuator row found.

title: TDK Taiwan carves out actuator business into Actutek Corp (effective 2026-01-01); sale to Q Tech by end-March 2026
detail: RM Department of 'Camera Module Actuator Solutions' transferred to wholly-owned Actutek Corporation effective 2026-01-01; 'subsequent sale of Actutek to Q Tech is expected to close by the end of March 2026'.

detail: Samsung Electro-Mechanics in advanced negotiations to supply fine-pitch coils for AF/OIS camera actuators (via Stemco JV with Toray) to an unnamed "global big tech" (hundreds of millions of smartphones/yr, notebooks, tablets, wearables, services) with "potenti

title: Actutek Corporation carve-out from TDK Taiwan becomes effective
detail: Per TDK Taiwan's 2025-11-14 notice, the camera-module actuator business transfers to Actutek effective 2026-01-01 ahead of the sale to Q Tech.

title: Alps Alpine CES 2026 driver-monitoring item; no XR/smart-glasses actuator news 2023–2026
detail: Only XR-adjacent item on Alps Alpine's English news list 2023–2026 is a 2026-01-05 CES driver-monitoring announcement; no smart-glasses actuator announcement found.

title: TDK: Actutek division effective date moved to 2026-01-15 (MOEA approval 2026-01-06)
detail: TDK Taiwan changed the Actutek carve-out effective date from 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-15.

title: TDK micro-actuator (VCM) assets being acquired by Q Tech's controlling shareholder
detail: Q Tech FY2025 deck notes TDK micro-actuator assets being folded into its actuator platform, so Q Tech can offer both VCM and TLens modules.

title: Actutek (ex-TDK actuators, Taiwan/Philippines) share transfer to QT Investment Group completed
detail: Q Tech's Aug-2026 circular: TDK restructured the business into Actutek in Jan 2026 "and the subsequent acquisition of Actutek by a member of the QT Investment Group (completed on 1 June 2026)", making Actutek a connected person. Tokyobrief: transfer effective

title: Mitsumi appears among Meta patent references for VCM-based camera solutions
detail: Meta filings describe VCM-based camera solutions with Mitsumi among references; no identified competing supply to the Meta glasses.
